title: JVMC-Just Vanilla MC
description: Just Vanilla Minecraft-This is the best project among other vanilla ones. You will be able to explore the world of Minecraft without leaving the vanilla Minecraft!
body:
Why should you download my project? Firstly, plain Minecraft without mods is too boring. Secondly, you'll get maximum enjoyment from the game with pleasant animations. And thirdly, you can enjoy all the vanilla features of this wonderful game.
I personally selected each mod, resource pack, and shader set, spending a lot of time on it. I hope you enjoy my project :)
